Travel burden is low: Helsinki, the hardest-hit municipality, is 3 km by road from HUS Syöpäkeskus, with 0 nights away for 15 breast sessions and 0 for 5 [S60, S36].

1. Within 30 days, the head of radiotherapy and the clinical team decide whether a single 8 Gy session should be the default for uncomplicated painful bone metastases, given equal pain relief but more retreatment [S31, S30]. For Helsinki, expected nights away are 0.0 with multi-fraction and 0.0 with single 8 Gy [S60]. It serves "Patients receive treatment within target times" [S25, S24].

2. Within 30 days, the head of radiotherapy and the clinical team decide whether 5 sessions should be the default for eligible patients (whole breast or chest wall, no nodal radiotherapy), as non-inferior to 15 [S9, S15, S14]. Distance is a reason to choose 5 sessions, removing 0 nights away and freeing 1,962 machine sessions a year in the county (calculated for breast) [S33, S57, S34, S35, S60]. It serves "National targets and key effectiveness indicators defined for agreed cancers" [S61].

3. Within 30 days, the quality manager and the clinical team decide which figures to report yearly on schedule mix and radiotherapy use by distance band [S26, S27]. It serves "Regional differences in treatment are available and used to steer services (cross-cutting indicator)" [S26].

Schedule mix is unknown and distances are modelled [S16, S59, S60].
